instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: WorkspaceMoss Archive Review manages workspace archiving from request through outcome. The Workspace Owner submits a request and retirement reason, the Access Coordinator records blockers, the Data Custodian records export readiness and excluded data categories, and the Compliance Reviewer records a retention restriction. The Workspace Service Operator archives only when no blocker is recorded and a retention restriction is present, then sends the outcome to the Owner. Blocking-item categories, excluded-data categories, and the outcome delivery channel remain undecided; permanent deletion and billing cancellation are excluded.

output.summary: WorkspaceMoss Archive Review manages workspace archiving from request through outcome. It records retirement reasons, blocking items, export readiness, excluded data categories, and retention restrictions before an eligible workspace is archived and its outcome is sent. Three category or delivery details remain unresolved, while permanent deletion and billing cancellation are excluded.
output.primary_goal: Manage workspace archiving from request through outcome.
key_capabilities: Submit an archive request and retirement reason.
Record export readiness and excluded data categories.
Archive only after eligibility conditions are met.
Send the archive outcome to the Workspace Owner.
unresolved_points: The outcome delivery channel remains undecided.
